description: Query your personal brain. Searches your saved context and automatically augments it with live web search results.
Limit the context search strictly to captures from the current group chat, combined with live web results.
Perform a live web search only, completely bypassing saved brain context.
Display capture statistics and a summary of your taste profile.
Interact with the bot inside group chats. @mentioning with a question queries the group's memory; @mentioning with notes or media captures them.
Share any URL in a group chat containing the bot. The link is passively scraped and indexed in the background without needing an @mention.
